Our Story

Built for IGCSE.
Driven by Results.

El7a2ny was founded by educators who believed that every student deserves access to expert tutoring — not just those who can afford elite schools.

🎯

Our Mission

To make world-class IGCSE tutoring accessible to every motivated student. We combine expert knowledge with personalised teaching to help students unlock their academic potential.

🚀

Our Vision

To become the leading IGCSE tutoring platform in the MENA region, empowering students to achieve not just good grades, but a genuine love for learning.

Journey

Our Story So Far

2020

Founded in Cairo

Started with 3 tutors and a vision to make quality IGCSE tutoring accessible to every student.

2021

Went Online

Expanded to fully online sessions, reaching students across Egypt and the MENA region.

2022

200 Students Milestone

Celebrated 200 active students and a 92% exam success rate across all subjects.

2023

Team Expanded

Grew to 12 expert tutors covering all IGCSE subjects with dedicated Cambridge-trained specialists.

2024

500+ Students & 95% Success

Reached over 500 students with a 95% success rate — our best year yet.
